2126429243081118100.en_summary: If you never believed in fibonacci maybe you do now? The recent $SPY low bottomed right at that 61.8% fib retracement of the entire rally since March-Oct. Now a move above 745 would confirm the new trend leg higher which would breach the 61.8% on opposite side.
2126429243081118100.zh_summary: 如果你從未相信斐波那契，也許現在會相信？最近 $SPY 的低點正好在自 3 月至 10 月整個反彈的 61.8% 斐波那契回撤位。現在突破 745 將確認新的上漲趨勢段，這將突破對側的 61.8%。

ticker_notes.SPY: Low at 61.8% fib of Mar-Oct rally; above 745 confirms higher trend

2126428156609351968.en_summary: $COHR continues to outperform the optics sector, and I think it stays that way. $AAOI has diluted shareholders relentlessly, so every rally gets sold into new shares. $LITE doesn't trade on its own story anymore, it's pegged to $MRVL's deal math. Most of the group carries some kind of overhang that caps the upside. $COHR is the one clean story.
2126428156609351968.zh_summary: $COHR 繼續跑贏光學板塊，我認為它會保持這樣。$AAOI 不斷稀釋股東，所以每次反彈都會被新股賣出。$LITE 不再按自己的故事交易，它被釘在 $MRVL 的交易數學上。該組大多數都有某種懸置，限制了上行。$COHR 是唯一乾淨的故事。

2126426700364104000.en_summary: $SPX percent of stocks above 200 day MA at 62.2% now after bouncing from the key 50% level that tends to define bull trends medium to long term. Breadth improving each day this week so still has some to prove but a good start for year end rebound after the clearing event the past week.
2126426700364104000.zh_summary: $SPX 高於 200 日均線的股票百分比現在為 62.2%，從關鍵的 50% 水平反彈，該水平往往定義中長期牛市趨勢。本週每天廣度都在改善，仍有待證明，但在過去一週的清理事件後，是年終反彈的良好開端。
